verdict: Organic engagement is holding; paid channels remain dark across all locations.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, no paid spend ran on Meta or Google Ads — zero dollars, zero paid leads. All engagement came from Google Business Profile, which collectively delivered 401 actions (23 calls, 257 direction requests, and 121 web clicks) in the last 28 days with no paid support behind it. Forte Metals was the standout, with GBP activity up 77% week-over-week, while O'Hare Precision held steady at +4%; Advance Grinding dipped 17% and has gone quiet in the last three days. Search visibility is also softening at O'Hare, with organic search clicks down 18% week-over-week, which we are monitoring closely alongside the GBP dip across locations.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations in the last 28 days
week-over-week rise in GBP engagement at Forte Metals, the strongest signal this period
paid spend across all locations and channels for the full 28 days

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement has gone quiet across Advance Grinding and O'Hare Precision in the last three days, and organic search clicks at O'Hare are trending down week-over-week.
watch_item.fix: We are reviewing profile completeness and recent activity on both listings to identify what changed, and organic search performance is being assessed to determine whether a content or visibility adjustment is needed.
